title: Evals: attach eval suites to route A/B experiments + quality delta report contract
creator: Jonas Weber
description:
## Context
Route-level A/B testing (Console-first) needs an optional **quality** surface area: attach an offline eval suite to an experiment, run the suite against each variant’s frozen configuration, compute **B vs A deltas** with confidence intervals, and make the results queryable by Console.

This ticket covers the eval-harness integration work + data contract needed for Console rendering. It does **not** cover exposure logging / online judge sampling (explicitly deferred).

References:
- Confluence: `Route-level A/B Testing: Eval Harness Integration (Offline Quality Deltas)` (owner: Olivia) — sources/confluence/applied-ml-and-evals/eval-harness/route-ab-testing-eval-integration.json
- Drive: `ab-quality-metrics-stat-plan` (Sana)

## Goals (v1 / beta)
1. Allow Console backend to **link** (attach) one or more eval suites to an experiment and trigger manual runs.
2. Run suite against both variants using a **frozen run manifest** (reproducible, pinned suite version + pinned model revision/config fingerprint).
3. Produce a **Quality Delta Report** artifact with:
   - per-metric A, B values
   - delta (B − A)
   - 95% CI for delta (bootstrap)
   - p-value where applicable + BH q-values (FDR)
   - warnings for low n / partial runs / non-determinism
4. Provide stable, versioned schema for Console consumption (`quality_delta_report_v1`).
5. Add contract tests and deterministic fixtures so Console can render without chasing schema drift.

## Non-goals (v1)
- Online judge sampling from production traffic / streaming capture.
- Custom user-defined metrics beyond eval harness supported metric types.
- A/B/n UI/analysis beyond 2-variant comparisons (report may carry more metadata, but UI will show pairwise vs chosen control only in later phase).

## Proposed integration (contract)
### Identifiers
- `experiment_id`: route-level experiment identifier from control-plane.
- `attachment_id`: record in Console backend DB for (experiment_id, suite_id, suite_version, run_policy).
- `run_id`: immutable eval run identifier.

### Variant config fingerprint
Console backend will pass a **frozen** variant config (or fingerprint inputs) to eval harness. Eval harness stores:
- `variant_config_fingerprint = sha256(canonical_json(config))`
- Canonicalization requirements: stable key ordering, normalized floats, explicit null handling.

### Artifact schema
A single JSON summary artifact per (experiment_id, attachment_id, run_id):
- `schema_version: quality_delta_report_v1`
- `experiment_id`, `attachment_id`, `run_id`
- `suite_id`, `suite_version`
- `variant_a` / `variant_b` (id, name, fingerprint)
- `n_items` + coverage info (if partial)
- `metrics[]`: metric_key, display_name, directionality, a_value, b_value, delta, delta_ci_low/high, test_name, p_value, q_value, notes
- `warnings[]`

Per-item outputs are optional for beta; if stored, keep behind suite-level policy and retention defaults (see Privacy).

### Stats (v1)
- Paired bootstrap when prompts are aligned (default for offline suites).
- 10k resamples default; allow config knob but cap runtime.
- q-values via Benjamini–Hochberg at FDR=0.10.
- Sample size warnings:
  - continuous: warn if n < 200
  - binary: warn if n < 500 (esp. for small deltas)
  - very low: n < 50

## Implementation plan
### Eval harness changes (this ticket)
1. Add “AB experiment run” entrypoint in eval orchestrator:
   - Accept run manifest containing suite_id/version and variant configs (A/B)
   - Enqueue per-variant suite executions
   - Persist per-variant aggregates
2. Implement delta reporter:
   - Join aligned item-level scores for A/B
   - Compute per-metric deltas + CI + p/q-values
   - Emit `quality_delta_report_v1` summary artifact
3. Add schema versioning + backwards-compat guardrails:
   - New fields must be optional
   - Console should be able to ignore unknown fields
4. Add contract tests + fixtures:
   - Golden report JSON checked in (with stable numbers)
   - Deterministic seed strategy per (run_id, item_id, variant_id)
   - Tests for canonicalization + fingerprint stability

### Console backend touchpoints (out of scope for this ticket, but define the contract)
- Console backend creates attachment record and triggers run.
- Console backend queries artifact by (experiment_id, attachment_id) and renders.

## Privacy / retention (needs security consult)
- Treat customer-defined suites as customer content.
- Default retention:
  - summary artifacts: 90 days
  - per-item details (if enabled): 14 days
- If suite is marked sensitive: do not store raw outputs; store scalar scores only.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Eval harness accepts a run manifest with frozen suite version + variant configs and produces two variant aggregates.
- [ ] Delta reporter produces `quality_delta_report_v1` artifact for B vs A.
- [ ] Report includes: delta + 95% CI + q-values for metrics with p-values.
- [ ] Warnings are populated for low n, partial coverage, or non-deterministic runs.
- [ ] Contract tests cover schema stability + fingerprint canonicalization.
- [ ] Reviewed by Applied ML (Jonas/Sana) for stats correctness and by Console (Dylan/Chloe) for schema usability.

## Risks / mitigations
- Compute cost: enforce org-level concurrency (default 2) + per-run token cap (5M) at orchestrator.
- Misinterpretation: ship warnings + require Console to show “offline eval may not match prod” banner.
- Schema drift: require golden fixtures + CI check.

## Open questions
- Do we support storing per-item examples for beta partners by default or opt-in per suite? (Current lean: opt-in; privacy.)
- Where does "primary_metric" live? (Likely Console attachment metadata; report still includes it if provided.)
- Partial results semantics: do we compute deltas on intersection of completed items only, or mark metric unavailable if coverage < threshold? (Proposed: compute on intersection, add explicit coverage fields + warning.)
comments: 2026-02-12 — Jonas Weber: Creating ENG ticket to track eval integration work. Please align implementation with the Confluence spec (Olivia) so Console doesn’t need bespoke adapters. Key constraints: reproducibility (suite_version pinning + variant fingerprint), explainability (CI + q-values), and low-risk rollout (manual runs only for beta).

2026-02-20 — Olivia Grant: Drafted run manifest + report schema (quality_delta_report_v1) locally. Biggest open item is canonicalization for fingerprinting inference params (float normalization). Proposing we reuse existing eval-harness canonical_json utility + add explicit float formatting (%.8g) to avoid noisy diffs.

2026-02-24 — Sana Farid: Reviewed stats approach. Paired bootstrap is fine for v1; ensure p-value computation is documented and we don’t present it as a classical t-test. For multiple comparisons, BH(FDR=0.10) is acceptable; Console should label "FDR-adjusted". Add a warning when n<50 that disables any “significant” badge even if q<0.10 (too misleading).

2026-02-28 — Logan Wright: Confirming this stays out of telemetry pipeline for beta (offline eval artifacts only). Please include report metadata fields needed for Console caching: generated_at, suite_version, variant fingerprints, and a stable artifact URI.

2026-03-05 — Olivia Grant: Opened PR in eval-harness: `github/eval-harness/pr_944_ab-experiment-quality-delta-reporter`. Includes schema v1, delta computation, and golden fixture test. Needs review from Jonas + Sana for stats and Dylan/Chloe for contract usability.

2026-03-07 — Dylan Brooks: Reviewed schema draft. Request: include `attachment_id` in report for easier query routing, and keep metric keys stable (snake_case) with a separate display_name for UI. Also please ensure unknown metrics don’t crash Console—null out optional stats fields when not computed.

2026-03-08 — Olivia Grant: Updated PR per feedback: added attachment_id + generated_at, split metric_key vs metric_display_name, and made p_value/q_value optional. Remaining: add coverage fields for partial runs + wire in the n<50 “no significance badge” hint via warnings[] so UI can follow it.
